scope: Developer attended battery boundary experiment only; no production admission or sustained safety claim
target: RZ09-0528, 1532:02C6, BIOS 2.02, exact existing firmware and device guards

entry.pad: Absent, two observations separated by at least 500 milliseconds
entry.external: Two fresh HWiNFO CPU and same-device NVML GPU observations at least 2 seconds apart; CPU <=70 C, GPU <=72 C, GPU utilization <=10 percent, independently confirmed zero offsets, no 3DMark process, attended no-workload confirmation

nativeWritePolicy: Existing exact-device, controller isolation, full-AC, pad and zero-offset guards remain unchanged for every setter; no battery writes

observation.bracket: Fresh Windows AC, 07/8C power, 0D/82 channels 1 and 2, 07/8C power, fresh Windows AC
observation.transitionalSample: A well-formed bracket whose 07/8C values, paired channels or Windows AC state change within one observation is discarded without poisoning, resets the full-AC stability window, and is retried within the same deadline; a mode 0 or unknown channel, malformed or uncertain native reads still poison
signals: BatteryObservedReconnectNow immediately on first coherent battery sample
AbortReconnectAc at most once, immediately on a tripwire, pad loss or any failed boundary
observation.limitations: No intentional battery dwell, external load, automatic HyperBoost re-entry, or assertion of exact total mode-7 residence

cleanup.required: Actual external worker quiescence, fresh Windows AC and two matching complete full-AC thermal observations separated by at least 1 second; setter guards independently verify GPU zero and isolation
cleanup.mode2: Verified no-op; no restore setter or acknowledgement claimed
cleanup.mode7: One existing guarded paired Performance restoration followed by paired readback
cleanup.other: Unknown, mixed, mode 0 or 3 on full AC, inconsistent brackets, native uncertainty or insufficient transaction reserve require pending manual recovery; no replay
cleanup.reserve: Four observation transactions plus at least eight reserved cleanup transactions
cleanup.telemetryFailure: Completed failed GPU/CPU samples may preserve coherent battery signaling and switch to fresh Windows-only recovery observation; a still-running external operation forbids cleanup
